svg.title: One decision
svg.desc: The harness says hello, sends an observation and the legal action ids, and the bot answers with one id. An illegal id or taking over five seconds is a forfeit. Then the harness says bye. Action ids: 0 to 1 dash, 2 to 51 bids, 52 with, 53 pass, 54 to 67 estimates, 68 to 119 cards.
